scope: Local fake TCP relay tests and read-only AppKit source review; no app, Sony, HID, guest, or real relay accessed

coverage: fragmented, malformed, truncated and silent greetings
remote EOF and unexpected data fail closed
250ms exact timeout and late write cannot revive session
near UInt64 maximum and regressed clock
watchdog independently closes while main thread is blocked
watchdog weak lifetime and deinit EOF
real nonblocking TCP backpressure and final EOF

backpressure.note: This run exercised would-block failure. Positive partial-write behavior is enforced by count != frame.count fail-close but was not separately induced.

socketFixes: check heartbeat expiry before any write so delayed watchdog cannot be bypassed by late input
review.focusStop: MacControlCore clears state on foreground/modifier changes; next 8ms tick sends neutral. Sleep/session resign, secure input, disabled tap, and stop close the output; no auto reconnect.
review.limits: These tests do not establish Sony game compatibility or actual USB device removal. Those are covered by separate parent-run receipts.
